name: IcoMoon Free
about: IcoMoon Free is a free, open-source icon set with 491 icons designed by Keyamoon. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under GPL.

faqs.q: Are IcoMoon Free free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 491 IcoMoon Free are open source under the GPL license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the GPL terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use IcoMoon Free in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many IcoMoon Free are there?
faqs.a: There are 491 icons in the IcoMoon Free set, designed by Keyamoon. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of IcoMoon Free?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are IcoMoon Free available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
